texts.text: Clip fasteners are used in a wide variety of industries and applications. Some examples of different types of clip fasteners include:
Cage nuts for tolerance compensation, efficient handling and reliable support
Clips and snap nuts for different sheet thicknesses
Spring plungers for fixing, locking, and positioning
Ball-ended thrust screws for tensioning, supporting, or clamping
Self-locking ball lock pins with push-button release for quick connection and release, corrosion-resistant and suitable for applications with high loads
Hose clamps for quick, safe installation in low-to-high-pressure applications
